about: [O7] The bounty board by real input: at the board by the police headquarters' door (a tool's teleport), 'E  the wanted board'; E: WANTED, three posters (a photo, a name, a district, a reward), the game held; E: put back. The first man stands on his corner of his turf; the night's revolver drawn by the wheel and shots by real clicks take him down; at the board, 'E  collect  $150', E: the money, his poster crossed and PAID. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o7_bounty.json

steps.eval: (window.__toBoard = () => { const B = G.night.bounty.board(); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(B.standX, B.standZ); N.controller.setPose(B.standX + B.nx * 0.4, B.standZ + B.nz * 0.4, Math.atan2(B.nx, B.nz), 0); return [B.x, B.z]; }, window.__toBoard())

steps.label: at the board: E  the wanted board
E: WANTED, three posters, the game held

steps.eval: (() => { const b = G.night.bounty.names()[0]; window.__b = b; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(b.x, b.z); const g = G.night.graph(); let px = b.x + 9, pz = b.z; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i * Math.PI / 8, q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + Math.cos(a) * 9, 0, b.z + Math.sin(a) * 9); const q0 = q.clone(); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.4); if (q.distanceTo(q0) < 0.05 && g.lineOfSight(q.x, q.z, b.x, b.z) && !G.stage.part('city').C.inWater(q.x, q.z)) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.02); G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(px, pz, 20); return [b.name, b.district, b.x, b.z]; })()

steps.label: the wheel: the night's revolver out

steps.eval: (() => { const h = G.night.bounty.men.get('b0'); const c = new N.THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixPosition(h.bones.chest.matrixWorld); const e = N.camera.position; N.controller.yaw = Math.atan2(-(c.x - e.x), -(c.z - e.z)); N.controller.pitch = Math.atan2(c.y - e.y, Math.hypot(c.x - e.x, c.z - e.z)); return 1; })()

steps.label: taken down: the night sees him fall
E: paid, the money, the card
